lead.question: 一只野生美洲狮出现在伦敦以南的乡间，它从哪里来，人们又如何追查？
lead.warmup: 伦敦动物园接连收到报告：在伦敦以南45英里的地方出现过一头野生美洲狮。起初没人把报告当真，但随着目击者越来越多，描述又出奇地相似，专家们不得不展开调查。搜寻行动在宁静的乡间展开，美洲狮却始终未被捕获，人们甚至开始猜测它的来历。
goals: 掌握 spot、accumulate、oblige、convince、corner 等动词的含义与用法。
学会 at large、in the possession of、a trail of 等短语在语境中的意思。
理解并运用过去完成时被动语态（had been spotted / reported）与现在完成被动。
掌握同位语从句、unless 条件句以及 must have done 表推测的用法。
lead.summary: 伦敦动物园接到报告：伦敦以南45英里处出现一头野生美洲狮，起初无人重视。随着证据积累、描述出奇相似，专家们不得不调查。搜寻十分困难，它行踪飘忽，只留下死鹿、兔子与爪印毛发。全国动物园均未报失，专家推断它出自私人收藏者并设法逃脱。数周搜寻仍未捕获，想到它仍在乡间逍遥，令人不安。
lead.tips: 记牢 spot 的过去分词是 spotted（双写 t）；a puma had been spotted 这类“过去完成＋被动”常用来交代更早发生的被动动作。标题里的 at large 别译成“大体上”，此处是“逍遥法外、未被捕获”。

questions.q: Where must the puma have come from?
questions.zh: 那只美洲狮一定是从哪儿来的呢？
questions.a: It must have been in the possession of a private collector and somehow managed to escape.
questions.aZh: 它一定是某位私人收藏者豢养的，不知怎么设法逃了出来。
questions.hint: 见课文倒数第二段：As no pumas had been reported missing... 全国动物园均未报失，故推断它出自私人收藏者并逃脱。

questions.q: Why did the experts from the Zoo feel obliged to investigate?
questions.zh: 动物园的专家们为什么感到有必要进行调查？
questions.a: Because the evidence began to accumulate and the descriptions given by people who claimed to have seen the puma were extraordinarily similar.
questions.aZh: 因为证据越来越多，而且声称见过美洲狮的人们所描述的情况出奇地相似。
questions.hint: 见课文第一段 as the evidence began to accumulate... for the descriptions ... were extraordinarily similar。

questions.q: According to the experts, under what condition will a puma attack a human being?
questions.zh: 据专家证实，美洲狮在什么情况下才会伤人？
questions.a: A puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered.
questions.aZh: 美洲狮非被逼得走投无路，是决不会伤人的。
questions.hint: 见课文 experts confirmed that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered。

questions.q: Why did the search for the puma prove difficult?
questions.zh: 为什么搜寻美洲狮的工作被证明十分困难？
questions.a: Because the puma was often observed at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the evening.
questions.aZh: 因为常常早晨在甲地发现它，晚上却在20英里外的乙地发现它的踪迹。
questions.hint: 见课文 The search proved difficult, for the puma was often observed at one place in the morning...

questions.q: Why does the writer find it 'disturbing' that the puma is still at large, and what does 'at large' mean here?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说想到美洲狮仍在乡间会感到“不安”？这里的 at large 是什么意思？
questions.a: Because a dangerous wild animal is still roaming free in the quiet countryside where people live and no one has caught it; 'at large' means free and not yet captured.
questions.aZh: 因为一头危险的野兽仍在有人居住的宁静乡间自由游荡、尚未被捕获；at large 意为“逍遥法外、未被捕获”。
questions.hint: 结合课文末句 It is disturbing to think that a dangerous wild animal is still at large in the quiet countryside。

exercises.q: 汉译英：随着证据越来越多，动物园的专家们感到有必要进行调查。
exercises.a: As the evidence began to accumulate, experts from the Zoo felt obliged to investigate.

exercises.q: 汉译英：美洲狮除非被逼得走投无路，否则不会伤人。
exercises.a: A puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered.
exercises.note: unless 引导条件状语从句

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为被动语态）：People did not take the reports seriously.
exercises.a: The reports were not taken seriously.
exercises.note: 一般过去时的被动语态

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为主动语态）：A wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London.
exercises.a: Someone had spotted a wild puma forty-five miles south of London.

exercises.q: 填空（用所给词的适当形式）：The puma was often ______ (observe) at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the evening.
填空（用所给词的适当形式）：The experts were now fully ______ (convince) that the animal was a puma.
改错（找出并改正一处错误）：As no pumas had been reported missing from any zoo in the country, this one must be in the possession of a private collector.
exercises.a: this one must have been in the possession of a private collector
exercises.note: 对过去的推测用 must have done

quiz.q: “a wild puma had been spotted”中 spot 的意思是？
“experts felt obliged to investigate”中 feel obliged to do sth. 意为？
quiz.note: feel obliged to do = 不得不做

quiz.q: 下面哪句正确表达了“美洲狮非被逼得走投无路不会伤人”？
options: A puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered.
A puma will not attack a human being unless it cornered.
A puma will not attack a human being unless cornering.
A puma will not attack a human being unless it will be cornered.
quiz.note: unless 从句用一般现在时

quiz.q: 标题 A Puma at Large 中 at large 的意思是？
“As no pumas had been reported missing...” 使用的是？
options: 过去完成时的被动语态

quiz.q: “as the evidence began to accumulate”中 accumulate 意为？
